description: This file defines the QpackEncoder class, which implements the QPACK header compression encoder used in QUIC connections. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and related internal classes for managing header encoding, dynamic table capacity, and stream error handling.

classes.name: QpackEncoder
classes.description: Main class responsible for encoding HTTP/2 headers using QPACK, managing dynamic table capacity, stream errors, and header stream encoding.

classes.name: QpackEncoder::DecoderStreamErrorDelegate
classes.description: Interface for handling errors on the decoder stream.

classes.name: QpackEncoder::NoopDecoderStreamErrorDelegate
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the error delegate that ignores errors.

methods.name: QpackEncoder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the encoder with an error delegate.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderList
methods.description: Encodes a list of headers for a given stream, optionally returning the byte count sent on the encoder stream.

methods.name: SetMaximumDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the maximum capacity of the dynamic header table.

methods.name: SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Sets the current dynamic table capacity and sends the instruction on the encoder stream.

methods.name: SetMaximumBlockedStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of streams that can be blocked.

methods.name: OnInsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Handles insert count increment notifications from the decoder stream.

methods.name: OnHeaderAcknowledgement
methods.description: Handles header acknowledgment for a stream.

methods.name: OnErrorDetected
methods.description: Handles errors detected on the decoder stream.

methods.name: set_qpack_stream_sender_delegate
methods.description: Sets the delegate for the QPACK stream sender.

methods.name: decoder_stream_receiver
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the decoder stream receiver.

methods.name: dynamic_table_entry_referenced
methods.description: Checks if any dynamic table entries have been referenced.

methods.name: maximum_blocked_streams
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of blocked streams.

methods.name: MaximumDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Returns the maximum dynamic table capacity.
